data.titulo: Foa 4—Yizilayɛ Belemgbunli Mɔɔ Lumua Kɔdwu Babelɔn Nlɔnu Zo
data.contenido:
Sɔɔlo rayɛle Yizilayɛ belemgbunli mɔɔ lumua. Noko Gyihova kpole ye, na ɔkpale Devidi kɛ belemgbunli ɔziele ɔ gyakɛ anu. Yɛbazukoa Devidi anwo edwɛkɛ dɔɔnwo. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔle kakula la ɔ nee Golayate kakanyinli ne honle. Amozii ɔnriandile ɔvile Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo mɔɔ ɛnee ɛva ɛya la anwo. Akee Abegeli anwo fɛlɛko zile ye aze wɔ ɛtane mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔyɛ la anwo.

Bieko, yɛbazukoa Devidi ara Sɔlɔmɔn, mɔɔ lile Devidi agya kɛ belemgbunli wɔ Yizilayɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ. Yizilayɛ arelemgbunli nsa mɔɔ lumuale la biala lile ebia ɛvolɛ 40. Wɔ Sɔlɔmɔn ewule nzi, bɛhyɛle Yizilayɛ anu bɛyɛle ye belemgbunlililɛ nwiɔ, sɔlɔ nee nyiakɛ belemgbunlililɛ.

Sɔlɔ mbusua 10 belemgbunlililɛ ne lile ɛvolɛ 257 kolaa na Aseleama azɛkye ye. Wɔ ye ɛvolɛ 133 anzi, yɛɛ bɛzɛkyele nyiakɛ mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne noko a. Wɔ mekɛ ɛhye anu bɛvale Yizilayɛma bɛhɔle nlɔnu wɔ Babelɔn. Ɔti Foa NNA ne ka ɛvolɛ 510 anwo tetedwɛkɛ, mɔɔ nuhua a ninyɛne mɔɔ yɛ azibɛnwo dɔɔnwo la sisile a.

NEA kɛ Samoɛle ɛlɛwola nwole agua nrenya ne ati zo ɛ. Zɛhae yɛɛ ɛnee bɛyɛ bɛkile kɛ bɛkpa awie kɛ belemgbunli a. Gyihova a hanle hilele Samoɛle kɛ ɔwola nwole ne ɔgua Sɔɔlo ati zo a. Ɔle nwole titile bie mɔɔ bɔ evuanlɛ kpalɛ.

Sɔɔlo ɛnee suzu kɛ ɔnfɛta kɛ ɔkɛyɛ belemgbunli. Ɔzele Samoɛle kɛ: ‘Mevi Bɛngyaman abusua nu, Yizilayɛ abusua ekpunli ne anu mɔɔ ɔle ekyi kpalɛ a. Duzu ati a ɛse mebayɛ belemgbunli a?’ Gyihova kulo Sɔɔlo edwɛkɛ ɔluakɛ ɔnyɛ ɔ nwo kɛ asɛɛ ɔle sonla kpole mɔɔ ɔ nwo hyia somaa a. Ɛhye ati a Ɔkpale ye kɛ belemgbunli a.

Noko Sɔɔlo ɛnle ehyianli anzɛɛ sonla ekyi. Ɔvi abusua mɔɔ bɛlɛ ezukoa la anu, na ɔle nrenya tendenle mɔɔ ɔ nwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ. Ɔwale ɔtɛla awie biala mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la! Sɔɔlo anwo yɛ se kpalɛ, na eza ɔ nwo yɛ ndɛ wɔ ɛnriandilɛ nu. Menli ne anye liele kɛ Gyihova ɛkpa Sɔɔlo kɛ belemgbunli. Menli ne kɔsɔɔti deanle nuhua kɛ: ‘Belemgbunli ne ɛnyi ɛhyɛ!’

Yizilayɛ agbɔvolɛ anwo yɛ se kɛ bolɛ. Na bɛtɛgyegye Yizilayɛma kpalɛ. Bɛziele Sɔɔlo belemgbunli bɛwiele la, yeangyɛ fee yɛɛ Amɔnoma rale kɛ bɛ nee bɛ baho a. Sɔɔlo boɔboale ɛlɔnema dɔɔnwo anloa na ɔlile Amɔnoma ne mɔ anwo zo konim. Ɛhye manle menli ne anye liele belemgbunli Sɔɔlo anwo.

Mekɛ hɔle ɔ nyunlu la, Sɔɔlo lile Yizilayɛma anyunlu ɔmanle bɛlile konim dɔɔnwo wɔ bɛ agbɔvolɛ nwo zo. Ɛnee Sɔɔlo lɛ ralɛ nrenya akɛnrasesebɛ bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwɔnatan a. Na Dwɔnatan boale manle Yizilayɛ lile konim dɔɔnwo wɔ konle nu. Ɛnee Filisitiama ne tɛde Yizilayɛma agbɔvolɛ. Kenle ko Filisitiama dɔɔnwo rale kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho.

Samoɛle hanle hilele Sɔɔlo kɛ ɔhendɛ kɔdwu kɛ ɔbara na yeabɔ afɔle anzɛɛ yeava ahyɛlɛdeɛ yeamaa Gyihova. Noko Samoɛle hyɛle somaa. Sɔɔlo ɛnee sulo kɛ Filisitiama ne mɔ bava konle ne adoa bɛ, ɔti ɔdaye mumua ne ɔbɔle afɔle ne. Awieleɛ kolaa ne mɔɔ Samoɛle rale la ɔhanle ɔhilele Sɔɔlo kɛ yeyɛ anzosesebɛ. Samoɛle zele kɛ: ‘Gyihova bakpa awie fofolɛ amaa yeali Yizilayɛ anwo zo belemgbunli.’

Amozii Sɔɔlo yɛle anzosesebɛ bieko. Yemɔti Samoɛle zele ye kɛ: ‘Ɔle kpalɛ kɛ ɛkɛdie Gyihova tɛla kɛ ɛkɛva boane mɔɔ ɛwie kye la ɛkɛmaa ye. Ɔluakɛ wɔandie Gyihova ane la ati, Gyihova ɛnrɛmaa ɛnrɛli Yizilayɛ azo belemgbunli bieko.’

Yɛkola yɛzukoa debie kpalɛ yɛfi ɛhye anu. Ɔkile kɛzi ɔhyia kɛ yɛtie Gyihova dahuu la. Eza yeanga ye zɔ, ɔkile kɛ sonla kpalɛ, kɛmɔ ɛnee Sɔɔlo de la, kola kakyi yɛ sonla ɛtane. Yɛngulo kɛ yɛkɛyɛ sonla ɛtane, ɔnle zɔ ɔ?1 Samoɛle tile 9 kɔdwu 11; 13:5-14; 14:47-52; 15:1-35; 2 Samoɛle 1:23. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐNWU mɔɔ ɛzi la ɔ? Kakula ne ɛlie boane ralɛ ne ɛvi ezizile ne asa nu. Ezizile ne rahyele boane ne kɛ ɔkali. Noko kakula ne doale ye na ɔliele boane ralɛ ne ɔvile ezizile ne anloa nu. Na ezizile ne hakyile ɔ nye wɔ ɔ nwo zo la, kakula ne hyele ye na ɔbɔle ye ɔhunle ye! Mekɛ bie noko ɔliele boane ne ko ɔvile awenade nloa nu. Asoo ɔnle kakula mɔɔ lɛ akɛnrasesebɛ? Ɛze ye sonla holɛ ɔ?

Kpavolɛ Devidi ɛne. Ɔvi Bɛtelɛhɛm. Ɔ nlenya a le Obɛde, Wulutu nee Bowaze ara nrenya ne. Ɛkakye bɛ ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ɔ ze Gyɛsi. Devidi a nea ɔ ze mboane ne a. Gyihova kpale Sɔɔlo kɛ belemgbunli la ye ɛvolɛ 10 anzi yɛɛ bɛwole Devidi a.

Mekɛ bie dwule la Gyihova hanle hilele Samoɛle kɛ: ‘Fa nwole titile na kɔ Gyɛsi aako nu wɔ Bɛtelɛhɛm. Meye ɔ mra mrenya ne mɔ anu ko kɛ mesie ye belemgbunli.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ Samoɛle nwunle Gyɛsi ara nrenya Yilayabe la, ɔhanle ye ɔ ti akunlu kɛ: ‘Nɔhalɛ, ɛhye yɛɛ Gyihova ɛkpa nu ɛye ye a.’ Noko Gyihova zele ye kɛ: ‘Mmanea ye anyinlima ne anwo anzɛɛ kɛzi ɔ anwo yɛ fɛ la. Tɛ ye mɔɔ yɛɛ meye ye kɛ belemgbunli a.’

Ɔti Gyɛsi vɛlɛle ɔ ra Abenadabe manle Samoɛle nleanle ye. Noko Samoɛle hanle kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, tɛ ɛhye noko a Gyihova ɛkpa ye a.’ Eza Gyɛsi vɛlɛle ɔ ra Hyama manle ɔrale. Na Samoɛle zele ye kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, Gyihova ɛmkpondɛ ɛhye noko.’ Gyɛsi manle ɔ mra nsuu ne mɔ amuala rale Samoɛle anyunlu, na Gyihova anye bɛ nuhua biala. Samoɛle bizale kɛ: ‘Na ɛ mra ne mɔ, bɛ muala ɛhye ɔ?’

Gyɛsi buale kɛ: ‘Yeha me awolɛ kazima ne. Na yehɔ ɔkanlea mboane ne mɔ.’ Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛ nee Devidi rale la Samoɛle nwunle kɛ ɔle kakula kɛnlɛma. Gyihova zele kɛ: ‘Ɛhye a mekpa nu meye a; fa nwole ne kpokpa ye.’ Zɔhane ala yɛɛ Samoɛle yɛle a. Mekɛ bie bara mɔɔ Devidi bayɛ Yizilayɛ belemgbunli a.1 Samoɛle 17:34, 35; 16:1-13. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

FILISITIAMA eza rale kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma baho. Devidi amediema mrenya mgbanyinli nsa ne boka Sɔɔlo ɛlɔnema ne anwo. Yemɔti kenle ko Gyɛsi zele Devidi kɛ: ‘Fa ma nee kpanwo kɔmaa ɛ mediema ne mɔ. Na nea kɛ bɛ nwo si de la.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ Devidi dwule ɛlɔnema ne azokoɛleɛ ne la, ɔnriandile ɔhɔle ɛlɔne ne anu ɔhɔkpondɛle ɔ mediema ne mɔ. Filisitiama Golayate kakanyinli ne rale kɛ ɔbagolo Yizilayɛma anwo. Ɛnee yeyɛ ɛhye kenle 40, nwonlomɔ nee nɔsolɛ. Ɔdeanle nu kɛ: ‘Bɛye bɛ sonla ko bɛmaa ɔ nee me yɛva konle ne yɛbɔ zolɛ. Saa ɔkola, ɔdi konim na ɔku me a yɛkɛyɛ yɛ nwo ahanra yɛkɛmaa bɛ. Na saa medame noko medi ɔ nwo zo konim, na meku ye a, bɛdabɛ noko bɛkɛyɛ yɛ ahanra. Saa bɛle mrenya a ɛnee bɛye awie bɛmaa me nee ye ɛho.’ Devidi bizale ɛlɔnema ne bie kɛ: ‘Duzu ahyɛlɛdeɛ a sonla mɔɔ kɛhu Filisitianli ɛhye na ɔkɛlie Yizilayɛ ɔkɛvi anyiemgba ɛhye anu la banyia a?’

Bɛbuale ye kɛ: ‘Sɔɔlo bamaa nrenya zɔhane anwonyia dɔɔnwo. Na ɔbava ɔ ra raalɛ ne yeamaa yeagya ye.’

Noko ɛnee Yizilayɛma ne amuala sulo Golayate ɔluakɛ ɔle sonla kpole kpalɛ. Ye tendenle kɛyɛ mita nsa, na sogyanli fofolɛ a lɛ ye enyinlike ne a.

Ɛlɔnema ne bie mɔ hɔhanle hilele Belemgbunli Sɔɔlo kɛ Devidi kpondɛ kɛ ɔ nee Golayate ko. Na Sɔɔlo hanle kɛ: ‘Ɛ nee Filisitianli ne ɛnrɛhola ko. Wɔmɔ ɛle kakula, na yemɔ sumunli ye mbɛda nu yeho toonwo.’ Devidi buale ye kɛ: ‘Mengunle ezizile nee awenade mɔɔ rahyele me ze boane la. Na Filisitianli ɛhye bayɛ kɛ bɛ nuhua ko ala la. Gyihova baboa me.’ Sɔɔlo zele kɛ: ‘Kɔ, Gyihova nee wɔ ɛhɔ.’

Devidi hɔle azudenle bie anloa na ɔvale awolɛ nnu ɔguale ye kodoku ne anu. Akee ɔvale ye totoabɔ ne na ɔhɔle kɛ ɔkayia kakanyinli ne. Mɔɔ Golayate nwunle ye la, ɛnee ɔnnwu debie mɔɔ ɔzɔho a. Ɔzuzule kɛ Devidi ɛhunlɛ bayɛ debie ekyi bie amaa ye.

Golayate se: ‘Wɔmɔ bɛla, na mebava wɔ nwonane meamaa nloma nee nane ali.’ Devidi noko zele kɛ: ‘Wɔmɔ ɛ nee konle dadeɛ, atwɛ yɛɛ baka tendenle a ɛra a, na mame, melɛba wɔ Gyihova duma nu. Ɛnɛ kenle ye, Gyihova baye wɔ awula me sa nu, na mebabɔ wɔ meado aze.’

Devidi hanle zɔhane wiele la ɔvale ɛnriandilɛ ɔhɔle Golayate anwo zo. Ɔyele bolɛ ko ye kodoku ne anu, ɔvale ɔwulale ye totoabɔ ne anu, na ɔvale ye anwosesebɛ muala ɔdole. Bolɛ ne hɔbɔle Golayate ati, na ɔdɔle aze ɔwule! Mekɛ mɔɔ Filisitiama ne nwunle kɛ bɛ kakanyinli ne ɛdɔ aze ɛwu la, bɛ muala bɛhakyile bɛ nwo na bɛ nriandile. Yizilayɛma ne voanle bɛ na bɛlile konim wɔ konle ne anu.1 Samoɛle 17:1-54. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Deɛ Mɔɔ Ɔti Ɔwɔ Kɛ Devidi Nriandi La
data.contenido:
DEVIDI hunle Golayate la anzi, Yizilayɛ safohyenle Abenɛɛ vale ye rale Sɔɔlo anyunlu. Sɔɔlo anye liele Devidi anwo kpalɛ. Ɔyɛle ye safohyenle wɔ ye ɛlɔnema ne anwo azo na ɔvale ye ɔhɔdɛnlanle ye aako nu.

Amozii, mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma sia avi bɛ nee Filisitiama konle nu ara la, mraalɛ ne mɔ dole edwɛne kɛ: ‘Sɔɔlo ɛhu apenle apenle, na Devidi ɛhu apenle apenle bulu.’ Ɛhye manle Sɔɔlo vale ɛya, ɔluakɛ bɛwulale Devidi anyunlunyia bɛdɛlale ɔdaye Sɔɔlo. Noko Sɔɔlo ara nrenya Dwɔnatan annyia zɔhane adwenle ne. Ɔhulole Devidi kpalɛ, na zɔhane ala yɛɛ Devidi noko hulole ye a. Yemɔti bɛbɔle bɛ nwo ɛwɔkɛ kɛ bɛbayɛ agɔnwolɛ dahuu. Devidi ze sanwule bɔ kpalɛ, na Sɔɔlo kulo edwɛne ne mɔɔ ɔbɔ la. Noko kenle ko Sɔɔlo nungule ɛhwenlɛ ne manle ɔyɛle debie ɛtane bie. Mekɛ mɔɔ Devidi ɛlɛbɔ ye sanwule ne la Sɔɔlo vale ye atwɛ ne na ɔdole, ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Mebɛtɛ Devidi wɔ bane ne anwo!’ Noko Devidi hwenle ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne na atwɛ ne anga ye. Amozii Sɔɔlo dole atwɛ ne bieko kɛ ɔfa yeawɔ Devidi na ɔvonle. Ɔti Devidi nwunle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnea ɔ nwo boɛ.

Ɛkakye ɛwɔkɛ ne mɔɔ Sɔɔlo bɔle la ɔ? Ɔhanle kɛ ɔbava ɔ ra raalɛ ne yeamaa nrenya ne mɔɔ ɔkɛhu Golayate la agyalɛ. Amozii Sɔɔlo hanle hilele Devidi kɛ ɔbahola yeagya ɔ ra raalɛ Maekale, na emomu ɔwɔ kɛ ɔdumua ɔku ye agbɔvolɛ Filisitiama ne anu 100. Suzu nwolɛ nea! Ɛnee Sɔɔlo lɛ anyelazo kɛ Filisitiama ne bahu Devidi. Noko bɛangola ye ku ɔti Sɔɔlo vale ɔ ra raalɛ ne manle Devidi gyale ye.

Kenle ko Sɔɔlo hanle hilele Dwɔnatan nee ye azonvolɛ ne mɔ kɔsɔɔti kɛ ɔkulo kɛ ɔku Devidi. Noko Dwɔnatan zele ɔ ze kɛ: ‘Mmafa ɛ sa ɛka Devidi. Ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane biala ɔtɛtiale wɔ. Emomu, debie biala mɔɔ ɔyɛle la, ɔvale ɔzonlenle wɔ. Ɔvale ye ngoane ɔdole esiane nu na ɔhunle Golayate, na ɛnwunle ye la, ɛlile fɛlɛko.’

Sɔɔlo diele ɔ ra ne na ɔbɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔnrɛyɛ Devidi ɛtane biala. Bɛvale Devidi bɛrale bieko, na ɔzonlenle Sɔɔlo kɛmɔ ɔyɛ ye dɛba ne ala la. Noko akee, kenle ko, mekɛ mɔɔ Devidi ɛlɛbɔ ye sanwule ne la, Sɔɔlo dole ye atwɛ ne hɔle Devidi anwo zo. Devidi yele ɔ nwo ɛkɛ, na atwɛ ne hɔwɔle bane ne anu. Ye fane nsa ne azo ɛne! Devidi nwunle kɛ ɔwɔ kɛ ɔnriandi!

Kenle ko zɔhane nɔsolɛ ne Devidi hɔle ɔdaye mumua ne ye sua nu. Sɔɔlo zoanle menli kɛ bɛhɔhu ye. Ɛnee Maekale ze kpɔkɛ mɔɔ ɔ ze ɛbɔ la. Yemɔti ɔzele ɔ hu kɛ: ‘Saa ɛnɛ nɔe wɔanriandi a, bɛbava wɔ funli ɛhyema.’ Yemɔti nɔe ne Maekale boale Devidi manle ɔvale nvɛzɛlɛ nu ɔnriandile ɔhɔle. Ɛnee ɔwɔ kɛ Devidi fa ɔ nwo sie ɛleka ngakyile kɛyɛ ɛvolɛ nsuu amaa Sɔɔlo annwu ye.1 Samoɛle 18:1-30; 19:1-18. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐZE raalɛ anwofɛlɛko ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba arayia Devidi la ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Abegeli. Ɔze nrɛlɛbɛ kpalɛ, na ɔmanle Devidi gyakyile ɛtane mɔɔ anrɛɛ ɔyɛ la. Noko kolaa na yɛazukoa yemɔ anwo edwɛkɛ la, maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɛlɛto Devidi la.

Devidi nriandile Sɔɔlo la anzi, ɔhɔveale bolɛ bɔne bie anu. Ɔ mediema mrenya ne mɔ nee ye abusua ne kɔsɔɔti doale ye wɔ ɛkɛ. Menli kɛyɛ 400 rale ɔ nwo ɛkɛ ne, na Devidi yɛle kpanyinli lile bɛ ti. Devidi akee hɔle Mowabema belemgbunli ne ɛkɛ na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ maa egya nee ɔmɔ ɛwoa ɛ nwo ɛke kɔkpula mekɛ mɔɔ menwɔnwu mɔɔ kɛzi me nwo zo la.’ Amozii Devidi nee ye menli ne mɔ hɔveale awoka ne mɔ anu.

Ɛhye anzi yɛɛ Devidi yiale Abegeli a. Ɔ hu Neebale le sukoavolɛ mɔɔ lɛ azɛlɛ. Ɔlɛ mboane 3,000 yɛɛ mbɔnkye 1,000. Neebale le nrenya mɔɔ ɔ ti yɛ se a. Na ɔ ye Abegeli anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ. Eza noko ɔze kpalɛ yɛ. Mekɛ bie bɔbɔ ɔliele ye abusua ne ngoane. Maa yɛnlea mɔɔ ɔyɛle la.

Devidi nee ye menli ne mɔ yɛle Neebale boɛ. Bɛbɔle ye mboane ne mɔ anwo bane bɛmanle ye. Ɔti kenle ko Devidi zoanle ye menli ne bie wɔ Neebale anwo kɛ ɔboa bɛ. Devidi menli ne mɔ radole Neebale nee ye sonvolɛma kɛ bɛlɛpepɛ mboane ne mɔ anwo enrinli. Ɛnee ɔle ɛvoyia mekɛ na ɛnee Neebale lɛ aleɛ dɔɔnwo. Yemɔti mɔɔ Devidi menli ne mɔ hanle la ɛne: ‘Yɛyɛ wɔ boɛ. Yɛboale yɛnleanle wɔ mboane ne mɔ, na yɛanwua bie. Yɛbodo wɔ, maa yɛ aleɛ.’

Neebale zele kɛ: ‘Menrɛva me aleɛ menrɛmaa menli mɔɔ le kɛ bɛdabɛ la.’ Ɔdendɛle koasea nu, na ɔhehanle edwɛkɛ ɛtane dɔɔnwo ɔvanenle Devidi anwo. Mekɛ mɔɔ menli ne ziale rale na bɛhanle mɔɔ zile la bɛhilele Devidi la, Devidi vale ɛya kpole. Ɔhanle ɔhilele ye menli ne kɛ: ‘Awie biala ɛva ye konle dadeɛ!’ Na bɛdɔle adenle zo kɛ bɛkahu Neebale nee ye menli ne mɔ.

Neebale mgbavolɛ ne mɔ anu ko mɔɔ dele mɔɔ Neebale hanle la, hɔbɔle Abegeli amaneɛ. Ndɛndɛ ne ala Abegeli zieziele aleɛ. Ɔvale ɔzoale asoaso ne mɔ na ɔdɔle adenle zo. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔyiale Devidi la, ɔvi ye asoaso ne azo ɔdwule aze na ɔhotole ɔzele kɛ: ‘Yɛmenle, mesɛlɛ wɔ, mmadwenle me hu Neebale anwo. Ɔle koasea, na ngoaseade a ɔyɛ a. Ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛne. Mesɛlɛ wɔ fa, na fa mɔɔ ɔzile la kyɛ yɛ.’

Devidi buale ye kɛ: ‘Ɛle raalɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛ. Wɔammaa meanli nzenralɛ meangu Neebale wɔ ye atisesebɛ nyɛleɛ ne anwo. Kɔ sua nu anzondwolɛ nu.’ Amozii, mɔɔ Neebale wule la, Abegeli rayɛle Devidi aye mɔ anu ko.1 Samoɛle 22:1-⁠4; 25:1-43. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

SƆƆLO bɔle mɔdenle bieko kɛ ɔkye Devidi. Ɔvale ye ɛlɔnema mɔɔ ze konle nye zo kpalɛ la 3,000 na bɛhɔle kɛ bɛkakpondɛ Devidi. Mekɛ mɔɔ Devidi dele ɛhye la, ɔzoanle ye menli ne bie kɛ bɛhɔli busia na bɛnlea ɛleka mɔɔ Sɔɔlo zokoɛle nɔe ne la. Akee Devidi bizale ye menli ne nwiɔ kɛ: ‘Bɛ nuhua boni a nee me kɛhɔ Sɔɔlo azokoɛleɛ ne a?’

Abehyae buale kɛ: ‘Medame a me nee wɔ kɔ a.’ Devidi adiema raalɛ Zɛluaya ara a le Abehyae. Mekɛ mɔɔ Sɔɔlo nee ye ɛlɔnema ne ɛlafe la, Devidi nee Abehyae yɛle bɛtɛɛ hɔle azokoɛleɛ ne. Bɛvale Sɔɔlo atwɛ ne nee ye dwora ne mɔɔ gyi Sɔɔlo ati sɔlɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Awie biala annwu bɛ anzɛɛ ande bɛ nganeɛ ɔluakɛ ɛnee bɛlafe bubotoo.

Nea Devidi nee Abehyae. Bɛnriandi bɛhɔ boka ne azo mɔɔ awie biala anyɛ bɛ ɛhwee a. Devidi deanle nu zele Yizilayɛma sogya kpanyinli ne kɛ: ‘Abenɛɛ, duzu ati a wɔangola wɔanzinza wɔ belemgbunli ne a? Nea! Belemgbunli atwɛ ne nee ye dwora ne wɔ nienwu?’

Sɔɔlo dunwuele. Ɔdele Devidi ane na ɔbizale kɛ: ‘Devidi, ɛdawɔ ɛ?’ Ɛnwu Sɔɔlo nee Abenɛɛ wɔ ɔ bo ɛkɛ ne ɔ?

Devidi buale Sɔɔlo kɛ: ‘Ɛhɛe, me awulae belemgbunli.’ Na Devidi bizale ye kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a ɛtɛfoa me kɛ ɛkye me a? Duzu munzule a mebɔ a? Nana, wɔ atwɛ ne ɛne. Maa wɔ menli ne mɔ ko ɛralie.’ Sɔɔlo zele kɛ: ‘Meyɛ ɛtane. Meyɛ koasea.’ Yemɔti Devidi hɔle ye ɛleka bie, na Sɔɔlo noko ziale hɔle sua nu. Devidi hanle ye ɔ ti anu kɛ: ‘Kɛ ɔkɛyɛ biala la, kenle ko Sɔɔlo asa baha me yeahu me. Ɔwɔ kɛ menriandi mekɔ Filisitiama maanle nu.’ Yemɔti mɔɔ ɔyɛle la ɛne. Devidi bɛlɛbɛlale Filisitiama ne manle bɛliele bɛlile kɛ akee ɔwɔ bɛ afoa.

Nzinlii Filisitiama hɔle kɛ bɛ nee Yizilayɛma kaho. Wɔ konle ne anu, bɛhunle Dwɔnatan nee Sɔɔlo. Ɛhye manle Devidi lile alɔbɔlɛ kpole, na ɔhɛlɛle nwolɛ edwɛne fɛlɛko bie, mɔɔ se: ‘Mesu wɔ, me diema Dwɔnatan. Ɛsonle bolɛ ɛmaa me somaa!’

Ɛhye anzi Devidi ziale hɔle suakpole Hibulɔn mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la azo. Konle zile menli mɔɔ kpale Sɔɔlo ara Yehyebɔhyɛte kɛ belemgbunli nee menli mɔɔ ɛnee kulo kɛ Devidi yɛ belemgbunli la avinli. Awieleɛ kolaa ne Devidi menli ne mɔ lile konim. Bɛziele Devidi belemgbunli la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ 30. Ɔlile belemgbunli wɔ Hibulɔn ɛvolɛ nsuu ne foa. Mralɛ mrenya mɔɔ ɔwole bɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la bie mɔ a le Amenɔn, Abesalɛm yɛɛ Adonaegya.

Mekɛ bie anu Devidi nee ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ hɔhovale suakpole kɛnlɛma bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛlusalɛm la. Dwowabe mɔɔ le Devidi adiema raalɛ Zɛluaya ara la, yɛɛ lile konle ɛhye anyunlu a. Ɛhye ati Devidi kpogyale ye zo na ɔyɛle ye safohyenle wɔ ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anwo zo. Akee Devidi bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi belemgbunli wɔ suakpole Gyɛlusalɛm azo.1 Samoɛle 26:1-25; 27:1-⁠7; 31:1-⁠6; 2 Samoɛle 1:26; 3:1-21; 5:1-10; 1 Edwɛkɛsisilɛ 11:1-⁠9. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

DEVIDI bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdi tumi wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm la, Gyihova manle ye ɛlɔnema ne lile bɛ agbɔvolɛ nwo zo konim dɔɔnwo. Ɛnee Gyihova ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava Keena azɛlɛ ne yeamaa Yizilayɛma. Awieleɛ kolaa, akee, ɔlua Gyihova moalɛ zo, ɛwɔkɛ azɛlɛ ne amuala rayɛle bɛ ɛdeɛ.

Devidi ze maanle bu kpalɛ. Ɔkulo Gyihova. Yemɔti mekɛ mɔɔ ɔhonle ɔvale Gyɛlusalɛm la mɔɔ ɔlumua ɔyɛle la a le kɛ ɔhɔvale Gyihova ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne ɔrale. Na ɛnee ɔkulo kɛ ɔsi ɛzonlenlɛ sua na ɔfa ɔsie nuhua.

Mɔɔ Devidi yɛle kpanyinli la, ɔyɛle nvonleɛ kpole bie. Ɛnee Devidi ze ye kɛ ɔle ɛtane kɛ ɔkɛva awie debie. Noko kenle ko nɔsolɛ nu, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee yevo ye sua ne ati zo la, ɔnwunle raalɛ anwo fɛlɛko bie. Bɛfɛlɛ ye Batehyɛba, na ɔ hu le ye ɛlɔnema ne anu ko mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Yulaya a.

Devidi hulole Batehyɛba kpole kpalɛ ɔti ɔmanle bɛhɔvale ye bɛrale ye sua nu. Ɛnee ɔ hu ɛhɔ konle. Devidi nee ye lale na nzinlii ɔnwunle kɛ yeva ɛkolɛ. Ɛhye gyegyele Devidi kpalɛ ɔti ɔvale nrɛlaleɛ ɔhɔmanle ye safohyenle Dwowabe kɛ ɔva Yulaya ɔdo konle ne ɛleka mɔɔ ɛyɛ se kpalɛ la amaa bɛahu ye. Mekɛ mɔɔ Yulaya wule la, Devidi gyale Batehyɛba.

Gyihova vale Devidi anwo ɛya kpole. Yemɔti ɔzoanle ye sonvolɛ Neetan kɛ ɔhɔha ye ɛtane ne ɔhile ye. Neetan a nee Devidi ɛlɛtendɛ wɔ ɛkɛ ne la. Devidi nlunle ɔ nwo wɔ mɔɔ ɔyɛle la anwo, yemɔti Gyihova angu ye. Noko Gyihova zele ye kɛ: ‘Ɔluakɛ wɔyɛ ɛtane ɛhye la ati ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo bara wɔ aako nu.’ Na amgba nea ngyegyelɛ mɔɔ Devidi yiale ye a!

Mɔɔ lumua la, Batehyɛba ara ne wule. Akee Devidi belamunli ralɛ Amenɔn hyele ɔ diema raalɛ Teemaa mialera nu ɔ nee ye lale. Devidi ara nrenya Abesalɛm vale ɛhye anwo ɛya kpole na ɔhunle Amenɔn. Nzinlii, Abesalɛm nyianle menli dɔɔnwo anyunlu ɛlolɛ, na ɔdaye mumua ne ɔziele ɔ nwo belemgbunli. Awieleɛ kolaa ne, bɛhunle Abesalɛm na Devidi lile konim. Amgba, Devidi yiale ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo.

Wɔ mekɛ ɛhye mɔ anu, Batehyɛba wole ralɛ nrenya na bɛdonle ye duma Sɔlɔmɔn. Mekɛ mɔɔ Devidi yɛle kpanyinli na ɔ nwo dole ye la, ɔ ra nrenya Adonaegya bɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔyɛ ɔ nwo belemgbunli. Yemɔti Devidi manle ɛsɔfo bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Zeedɔko la vale nwole guale Sɔlɔmɔn ati zo mɔɔ kile kɛ Sɔlɔmɔn a bayɛ belemgbunli a. Yeangyɛ yɛɛ Devidi wule a, ɛnee yenyia ɛvolɛ 70. Ɔlile ebia ne ɛvolɛ 40, noko kɛkala Sɔlɔmɔn a le Yizilayɛ belemgbunli a.2 Samoɛle 11:1-27; 12:1-18; 1 Arelemgbunli 1:1-48. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

SƆLƆMƆN rayɛle belemgbunli la ɛnee ɔtɛdwule ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ. Ɔhulole Gyihova, na ɔlile folɛdulɛ mɔɔ ɔ ze Devidi vale manle ye la azo. Gyihova anye liele Sɔlɔmɔn anwo, yemɔti kenle ko nɔɔzo ɔhanle ɔhilele ye wɔ ɛlalɛ nu kɛ: ‘Sɔlɔmɔn, duzu a ɛkpondɛ kɛ meyɛ memaa wɔ a?’

Sɔlɔmɔn buale kɛ: ‘Gyihova me Nyamenle, mele kakula somaa kɛ mekɛli belemgbunli. Yemɔti maa me nrɛlɛbɛ maa menva menzie wɔ menli ne wɔ adenle kpalɛ zo.’

Gyihova anye liele mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn bizale la anwo. Yemɔti ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Ɔluakɛ wɔbiza nrɛlɛbɛ na wɔambiza ngoane tendenle anzɛɛ anwonyia la ati, mebamaa wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ kpole mɔɔ tɛla awie biala mɔɔ ɛdɛnla azɛlɛ ye azo ɛlɛ la. Akee debie mɔɔ wɔambiza bɔbɔ la mebava meamaa wɔ, ɛbanyia ɛ nwo, wɔanyia ɛ nyunlu.’

Mekɛ ekyi guale nu la mraalɛ nwiɔ bie vale edwɛkɛ ɛsesebɛ bie radole Sɔlɔmɔn anyunlu. Ko hanle kɛ: ‘Me nee raalɛ ɛhye de aako ko anu. Menwole ralɛ nrenya na ye kenle nwiɔ anzi ɔdaye noko ɔwole kakula nrenya. Kenle ko nɔɔzo ɔ ra ne wule. Na mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee me wɔ nafelɛ nu la ɔradwule me ra ne na ɔvale ye ɛdeɛ ne mɔɔ ɛwu la ɔdole me nwo ɛkɛ ne. Mɔɔ mendunwuele na menwunle kakula ne la, menwunle kɛ tɛ me ra ne ɔ?’

Raalɛ ko ne buale kɛ: ‘Ɔle adalɛ! Me ra ɛdeɛ ne a anye wɔ zolɛ la, ye ɛdeɛ ne a ɛwu la!’ Alumua raalɛ ne ɔdaye ɔse: ‘Kyɛkyɛ! Wɔ ɛdeɛ ne a ɛwu la, me ra ɛdeɛ ne a anye wɔ zolɛ la!’ Kɛ mraalɛ ne mɔ kpolerazulɛ ne hɔle ye la ɛne. Duzu a Sɔlɔmɔn bayɛ a?

Ɔzoanle ɔmanle bɛhɔvale dadeɛ bɛrale, na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛhyɛ kakula ne mɔɔ anye wɔ zolɛ la anu nwiɔ, na bɛmaa mraalɛ ne mɔ biala ɛva foa ko.’ Kakula ne ɔ nli mumua ne deanle nu kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ! Mesɛlɛ wɔ mmaku kakula ne. Fa maa ye!’ Na raalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne dele ye ɔ nloa na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Mmafa ɛmaa yɛ nuhua biala; maa bɛhyɛ nu.’

Awieleɛ kolaa ne Sɔlɔmɔn zele kɛ: ‘Mmaku kakula ne! Fa ye maa raalɛ ne mɔɔ lumua rale la. Ɔdaye a ɔwole kakula ne a.’ Sɔlɔmɔn nwunle ɛhye ɔluakɛ ɔ nli mumua ne kulo adɔma ne kpalɛ ɔti ɔhulole kɛ bɛkɛva ye bɛkɛmaa raalɛ ɛhendeɛ ne amaa bɛangu ye. Menli ne dele ndɛne ne mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn buale la, bɛ nye liele kpole kɛ bɛnyia belemgbunli mɔɔ ze nrɛlɛbɛ zɛhae a.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn lile ebia ne la, Nyamenle yilale menli ne na ɔmanle bɛ azɛlɛ ne hyenle aleɛ mɔɔ le kɛ vanye, feege, hwiiti nee ma ngakyile dɔɔnwo. Menli ne hedale ndanlɛ mgbalɛ na bɛdɛnlanle azua ngɛnlɛma nu. Awie biala nyianle debie biala mɔɔ ɔkpondɛ la.1 Arelemgbunli 3:3-28; 4:29-34. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

KOLAA na Devidi awu la, ɔvale ngyehyɛleɛ mɔɔ vi Nyamenle ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ kile kɛzi ɔwɔ kɛ bɛsi Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne la anwo ngɛlata ɔmanle Sɔlɔmɔn. Wɔ ye belemgbunlililɛ ne ɛvolɛ ne mɔɔ tɔ zo nna la anu, Sɔlɔmɔn bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsi ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne, na ɔlile ɛvolɛ nsuu nee foa kolaa na bɛawie ye si. Menli apenle apenle yɛle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anwo gyima, na bɛzɛkyele ezukoa dɔɔnwo wɔ nwolɛ; ɔluakɛ bɛvale ezukoa nvutuke nee dwɛtɛ fufule dɔɔnwo a bɛzile a.

Ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne lɛ ekpumgbunli nwiɔ, kɛmɔ ɛnee ɛdanlɛ sua ne de la. Noko ekpumgbunli ɛhye mɔ le ɛdanlɛ sua ne ɛdeɛ ne mɔnwo nwiɔ. Sɔlɔmɔn manle bɛvale ngyekyeleɛ ɛlɛka ne bɛziele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne suakunlu ekpumgbunli ne anu, na bɛvale ninyɛne mɔɔ ɛha mɔɔ ɛnee wɔ ɛdanlɛ sua ne anu la bɛguale ekpumgbunli ɛhendeɛ ne anu.

Bɛwiele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne si la, bɛlile ɛvoyia kpole bie. Sɔlɔmɔn hotole ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anyunlu na ɔyɛle asɔne, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ne anu la. Sɔlɔmɔn zele Gyihova kɛ: ‘Anwuma nehane tɛtɛtɛlɛlɛ ne bɔbɔ ɛnzo lɔ, na akee ɛzonlenlɛ sua ekyi ɛhye. Noko akee, O me Nyamenle, anrɛɛ tie wɔ menli saa bɛkakyi bɛ nye wɔ ɛke na bɛsɛlɛ wɔ a.’

Sɔlɔmɔn wiele asɔne ne yɛ la, senle vi anwuma rale. Ɔyelale nane afɔle ne mɔɔ bɛziezie la amuala. Na wienyi kpole bie mɔɔ vi Gyihova ɛkɛ ne la rayile ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Ɛhye kile kɛ ɛnee Gyihova ɛlɛtie, na ɔ nye liele ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne nee Sɔlɔmɔn asɔneyɛlɛ ne anwo. Akee ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne ragyinlanle ɛdanlɛ sua ne agyakɛ anu na ɔrayɛle ɛleka mɔɔ menli ne basonle a. Sɔlɔmɔn bule ye manle ne wɔ nrɛlɛbɛ nu mekɛ tendenle, na menli ne anye liele kpalɛ. Noko Sɔlɔmɔn gyale mraalɛ dɔɔnwo vile maanle ngakyile mɔɔ bɛnzonle Gyihova la azo. Ɛnwu ko kɛ ɔlɛsonle abaaba ne ɔ? Awieleɛ ne Sɔlɔmɔn aye mɔ manle ɔzonlenle awozonle dɔɔnwo. Asoo ɛze mɔɔ zile mekɛ mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle ɛhye la ɔ? Yeannea menli ne mɔ anwo zo kpalɛ bieko. Ɔ ti rayɛle se, na menli ne anye anlie bieko.

Ɛhye manle Gyihova vale Sɔlɔmɔn anwo ɛya na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Mebalie belemgbunlililɛ ne meavi ɛ sa nu na meava meamaa awie fofolɛ. Menrɛyɛ ɛhye wɔ wɔ mekɛ zo, emomu mebalie ye wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ ɛ ra nrenya ɛlɛdi ebia la. Noko menrɛlie belemgbunlililɛ ne amuala wɔ ɛ ra ne asa nu.’ Maa yɛnlea kɛzi ɛhye zile la.1 Edwɛkɛsisilɛ 28:9-21; 29:1-⁠9; 1 Arelemgbunli 5:1-18; 2 Edwɛkɛsisilɛ 6:12-42; 7:1-⁠5; 1 Arelemgbunli 11:9-13. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti nrenya ɛhye ɛlɛtete ye tɛladeɛ ne anu la ɔ? Gyihova a zele ye kɛ ɔyɛ a. Nrenya ɛhye a le Nyamenle ngapezonli Ahaegya. Ɛze awie mɔɔ le ngapezonli la ɔ? Ɔle sonla mɔɔ Nyamenle ka ninyɛne mɔɔ bazi kenlebie la anwo edwɛkɛ kile ye a.

Wɔ ɛke Ahaegya ɛlɛtendɛ ahile Gyɛlɔbowam. Gyɛlɔbowam le nrenya bie mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn manle ɔyɛle ye suazilɛ gyima ne bie a. Mekɛ mɔɔ Ahaegya yiale Gyɛlɔbowam wɔ adenle ne azo la, Ahaegya yɛle azibɛnwo debie bie. Ɔyele tɛladeɛ fofolɛ ne mɔɔ ɔwula la na ɔsuosuanle nuhua ngyebangyeba 12. Ɔzele Gyɛlɔbowam kɛ: ‘Die tɛladeɛ azinli azinli ye anu 10 fa.’ Ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti Ahaegya vale azinli 10 manle Gyɛlɔbowam a?

Ahaegya hilele nuhua kɛ Gyihova balie belemgbunlililɛ ne avi Sɔlɔmɔn asa nu. Ɔhanle kɛ Gyihova bava mbusua 10 amaa Gyɛlɔbowam. Ɛhye kile kɛ mbusua nwiɔ pɛ a baha amaa Sɔlɔmɔn ara nrenya Rilihɔbowam ali bɛ nwo zo tumi a.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Sɔlɔmɔn dele mɔɔ Ahaegya hanle hilele Gyɛlɔbowam la, ɔvale ɛya kpole. Ɔbɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔku Gyɛlɔbowam. Na Gyɛlɔbowam nriandile hɔle Yigyibiti. Mekɛ guale nu ekyii la Sɔlɔmɔn wule. Ɔlile ebia ɛvolɛ 40, na akee bɛyɛle ɔ ra nrenya Rilihɔbowam belemgbunli. Wɔ Yigyibiti, Gyɛlɔbowam dele kɛ Sɔlɔmɔn ɛwu, ɔti ɔziale ɔrale Yizilayɛ.

Rilihɔbowam ɛnle belemgbunli kpalɛ. Ɔhilele menli ne nyane bɔbɔ ɔdɛlale mɔɔ ɔ ze Sɔlɔmɔn yɛle la. Gyɛlɔbowam nee menli titile bie hɔle Belemgbunli Rilihɔbowam ɛkɛ ne na bɛzɛlɛle ye kɛ ɔbɔ mɔdenle na ɔ nee bɛ ɛli wɔ adenle kpalɛ zo. Noko akee Rilihɔbowam andie. Akee bɔbɔ avuanyi alumua deɛ ne. Yemɔti menli ne vale Gyɛlɔbowam ziele mbusua 10 ne azo belemgbunli, na Rilihɔbowam hɔle zo yɛle mbusua nwiɔ ne mɔɔ le Bɛngyaman nee Dwuda la azo belemgbunli.

Gyɛlɔbowam angulo kɛ ye menli ne kɔsonle wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu. Ɔti ɔyɛle ezukoa nvutuke nlankɛ mralɛ nwiɔ na ɔmanle mbusua 10 belemgbunlililɛ ne zonlenle bɛ. Yeangyɛ biala basabasayɛlɛ nee ɛtanelilɛ bule maanle ne anu.

Ngyegyelɛ noko wɔ mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anu. Rilihɔbowam ralile ebia ne la yeandwu ɛvolɛ nnu yɛɛ Yigyibiti belemgbunli rale kɛ ɔ nee Gyɛlusalɛm baho a. Ɔvale agudeɛ dɔɔnwo ɔvile Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu ɔhɔle. Ɔti mekɛ ekyi bie ala yɛɛ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne yɛle kɛmɔ ɛnee ɔde wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛzile la a.1 Arelemgbunli 11:26-43; 12:1-33; 14:21-31. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

MEKƐ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Gyɛlɔbowam wule la, arelemgbunli mɔɔ lile Yizilayɛ sɔlɔ mbusua 10 belemgbunlililɛ ne azo la biala yɛle ninyɛndane. Belemgbunli Ehabe ɛdeɛ ne bo bɛ muala bɛ nwo zo. Ɛze mɔɔ manle ɔrale ye zɔ la ɔ? Mɔɔ manle ɔrale ye zɔ la a le ɔ ye Gyɛzɛbɛle, Belemgbunli Raalɛ atisesebɛ ne.

Gyɛzɛbɛle ɛnle Yizilayɛnli raalɛ. Saedɛn belemgbunli ne ara raalɛ ɔ? Ɛnee ɔsonle adalɛ nyamenle Beeyale na ɔmanle Ehabe nee Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo noko zonlenle Beeyale. Ɛnee Gyɛzɛbɛle kpɔ Gyihova na ɔhunle ye ngapezoma ne anu dɔɔnwo. Bie mɔ hɔveale bolɛ bɔne nu amaa bɛangu bɛ. Saa Gyɛzɛbɛle kpondɛ debie avi awie ɛkɛ ne na ɔ sa ɛnga ye a, ɔku ahenle ne bɔbɔ na ɔdie.

Kenle ko Belemgbunli Ehabe arɛle bɔle. Ɔti Gyɛzɛbɛle bizale ye kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a ɛ rɛle ɛbɔ a?’

Ehabe buale kɛ: ‘Mɔɔ Neebɔto zele me la ati ɔ. Ɛnee mekulo kɛ metɔ ye vanye ɛya ne. Noko ɔse ɔfa ɔmaa me a ɔnyɛ boɛ.’

Gyɛzɛbɛle se: ‘Mmadwenle nwo. Mebalie meamaa wɔ.’

Yemɔti Gyɛzɛbɛle hɛlɛle ngɛlata nwanle mgbanyima mɔɔ nee Neebɔto wɔ sua ne azo la. Ɔhanle ɔhilele bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛkpondɛ mrenya mɔɔ nvasoɛ ɛnle bɛ nwo zo la na bɛmaa bɛdo Neebɔto ɛzonle kɛ yewa Nyamenle nee belemgbunli ne amonle. Na akee bɛva Neebɔto bɛhɔ suakpole ne anzi na bɛzi ye awolɛ bɛhu ye.’

Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛzɛbɛle dele kɛ Neebɔto ɛwu ala la, ɔzele Ehabe kɛ: ‘Dwazo na kɔva ye vanye ɛya ne.’ Asoo ɛnlie ɛndo nu kɛ Gyɛzɛbɛle fɛta anzohwenlɛ wɔ ɛtane kpole ɛhye anwo ɔ?

Yemɔti, mekɛ hɔle bie la, Gyihova zoanle Gyihu manle ɔhɔhwenle ɔ nzo. Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛzɛbɛle dele kɛ Gyihu ɛlɛba la, ɔhehanle ɔ nye anzi na ɔbɔle mɔdenle kɛ ɔmaa ɔ nwo ayɛ fɛ kpalɛ. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ Gyihu ranwunle Gyɛzɛbɛle kɛ ɔgyi nvɛzɛlɛ ne anu la, ɔvɛlɛle menli mɔɔ wɔ belemgbunli sua nu ɛkɛ ne la bie kɛ: ‘Bɛvuandi ye bɛde ye aze!’ Menli ne yɛle ye zɔ, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ nvoninli ye anu la. Bɛvuandinle ye bɛdele aze na ɔwule. Belemgbunli Raalɛ Gyɛzɛbɛle atisesebɛ ne awieleɛ ɛne.1 Arelemgbunli 16:29-33; 18:1-⁠4; 21:1-16; 2 Arelemgbunli 9:30-37. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuya

ASOO ɛze mrenya ɛhye mɔ na ɛze debie mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ a? Bɛlɛkɔ konle, na mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ lumua la ɛlɛto edwɛne. Noko wɔannea ɛkɛbiza kɛ: ‘Duzu ati a edwɛndovoma ne mɔ ɛnlɛ dadeɛ nee atwɛ mɔɔ bɛfa baho a?’ Maa yɛnlea.

Gyɛhɔhyafate a le Yizilayɛ mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne azo belemgbunli a. Ɔdɛnlanle aze wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Ehabe nee Gyɛzɛbɛle lile sɔlɔ mbusua 10 belemgbunlililɛ ne azo la. Gyɛhɔhyafate le belemgbunli kpalɛ, na kɛ ɛnee ɔ ze Esa noko de ala ɛne. Yemɔti menli mɔɔ wɔ nyiakɛ mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne anu la nyianle asetɛnla kpalɛ wɔ mekɛ dɔɔnwo anu.

Noko akee edwɛkɛ bie zile mɔɔ manle menli ne ahonle dule a. Menli bie rabɔle Gyɛhɔhyafate amaneɛ kɛ: ‘Ɛlɔnema mɔɔ vi Mowabe, Amɔn, nee Siyɛ Boka ne azo la ɛva yɛ aze.’ Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo bɔle gua wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm kɛ bɛkpondɛ Gyihova ɛkɛ ne moalɛ. Bɛhɔle ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu, na ɛkɛ ne yɛɛ Gyɛhɔhyafate yɛle asɔne kɛ: ‘O Gyihova yɛ Nyamenle, yɛnnwu mɔɔ yɛyɛ a. Yɛnlɛ anwosesebɛ biala wɔ ɛlɔnema ɛhye anyunlu. Ɛ nyunlu ala a yɛ nye gyi a.’

Gyihova diele, na ɔmanle ye sonvolɛ ne mɔ ko hanle hilele menli ne kɛ: ‘Konle ne ɛnle bɛ konle, ɔle Nyamenle ɛdeɛ. Ɔnrɛhyia kɛ bɛkɛho. Bɛmɛ bɛgyinla , na bɛnlea kɛ Gyihova bazi alie bɛ la.’

Yemɔti aleɛ hyenle la Gyɛhɔhyafate zele menli ne kɛ: ‘Bɛlie Gyihova bɛli!’ Akee ɔvale edwɛndovoma ɔlile ɛlɔnema ne ati, na bɛdole edwɛne bɛyele Gyihova ayɛlɛ bɛlile menli ne anyunlu. Asoo ɛze mɔɔ zile mekɛ mɔɔ bɛbikyele azokoɛleɛ ne la ɔ? Gyihova manle agbɔvolɛ ne mɔ nee bɛ nwo honle. Na mekɛ mɔɔ Yizilayɛma hɔdwule ɛkɛ ne la, ɛnee ɛlɔnema ne amuala ɛwu!

Asoo nrɛlɛbɛ ɛnle nu kɛ Gyɛhɔhyafate nyianle diedi wɔ Gyihova anu la ɔ? Saa yɛdayɛ noko yɛdie Ye yɛdi a yɛbayɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma.1 Arelemgbunli 22:41-53; 2 Edwɛkɛsisilɛ 20:1-30. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Ngakula Nwiɔ Mɔɔ Nyianle Ngoane Bieko
data.contenido:
SAA ɛnee wɔwu yɛɛ bɛdwazole wɔ bɛrale ngoane nu a, anrɛɛ kɛzi ɛ nli bade nganeɛ ɛ? Anrɛɛ ɔ nye balie kpole! Noko asoo awie mɔɔ kɛwu la bahola ara ngoane nu bieko ɔ? Bie ɛzi ɛlɛ ɔ?

Nea nrenya ne mɔɔ gyi ɛke la, nee raalɛ ne nee kakula ekyi ne. Nrenya ne a le ngapezonli Yilaegya. Raalɛ ne le kunlavolɛ mɔɔ vi suakpole Zalefate azo, na kakula nrenya ne le ɔ ra. Kenle ko bie kakula ne anwo dole ye. Anwodolɛ ne rayɛle anwonyane kpole na nzinlii ɔwule. Yilaegya zele raalɛ ne kɛ: ‘Fa kakula ne maa me.’

Yilaegya vale kakula ne mɔɔ ɛwu la vole ɛbolɔnsam ne azo na ɔvale ye ɔdole ɛkpa ne azo. Akee ɔyɛle asɔne kɛ: ‘O Gyihova, maa kakula ne ɛrɛla ngoane nu bieko.’ Kakula ne bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔdie ɛnwomenle! Ɛkɛ ne ala Yilaegya vale kakula ne dwule aze na ɔzele raalɛ ne kɛ: ‘Nea, ɛ ra ne ɛde kpɔkɛ!’ Ɛhye ati a ɔ nli anye ɛlie kpole la.

Gyihova ngapezonli bieko mɔɔ anwo hyia la a le Yilaehya. Ɛnee ɔsonle kɛ Yilaegya boavolɛ. Na amozii Gyihova luale Yilaehya noko anwo zo ɔyɛle nwanwane ninyɛne. Kenle ko Yilaehya hɔle suakpole Hyunɛm azo, na raalɛ bie yɛle ye moalɛ kpole bie. Amozii raalɛ ne wole kakula nrenya.

Kenle ko nwonlomɔ, mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee kakula ne ɛnyi la anzi, ɔdoale ɔ ze mɔɔ ɛnee ɔlɛyɛ gyima la wɔ ɛya ne anu. Arɛlevilɛ nu ala kakula ne deanle nu kɛ: ‘Me ti!’ Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛvale ye bɛrale sua nu la, kakula ne wule. Nea alɔbɔlɛ mɔɔ hanle ɔ nli a! Ndɛndɛ ne ala ɔhɔvɛlɛle Yilaehya.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Yilaehya rale la, ɔvale kakula ne mɔɔ ɛwu la ɔhɔle sua ne anu. Ɔzɛlɛle Gyihova, na ɔbutule kakula ne anwo zo. Yeangyɛ kakula ne anwo yɛle wuluwulu, na ɔnwuasinle fane nsuu. Nea kɛzi ɔ nli anye liele mekɛ mɔɔ ɔnwunle kɛ ɔ ra ne ɛnyia ngoane la!

Menli dɔɔnwo ɛwu. Ɛhye ɛmaa bɛ mbusua nee agɔnwolɛma ɛli nyane dɔɔnwo. Yɛnlɛ tumi mɔɔ yɛkola yɛmaa mɔwuamra dwazo a. Noko Gyihova lɛ zɔhane tumi ne. Amozii yɛbazukoa kɛzi ɔbava menli mgbe mgbe dɔɔnwo yeazia yeara ngoane nu bieko la anwo debie.1 Arelemgbunli 17:8-24; 2 Arelemgbunli 4:8-37. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Kakula Raalɛ Bie Boale Nrenya Tumivolɛ Bie
data.contenido:
ƐZE edwɛkɛ mɔɔ kakula raalɛ ekyi ne ɛlɛka la ɔ? Ɔlɛka Gyihova ngapezonli Yilaehya yɛɛ nwanwane ninyɛne mɔɔ Gyihova dua ɔ nwo zo yɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ yeahile bɛlɛra ne. Bɛlɛra ne ɛnze Gyihova anwo edwɛkɛ ɔluakɛ ɔnle Yizilayɛnli. Akee maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti kakula raalɛ ne wɔ bɛlɛra ne sua nu la.

Bɛlɛra ne le Seleanli. Ɔ hu a le Neeman, mɔɔ le Selea ɛlɔnema ne azo safohyenle kpanyinli la. Seleama hyele Yizilayɛnli kakula raalɛ ekyi ɛhye, na bɛvale ye bɛrɛlɛle Neeman aye ne kɛ ɔyɛ ye sonvolɛ.

Neeman lɛ ewule ɛtane bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye kokobɛ la. Ewule ɛhye kola maa awie nwonane ne bie bɔbɔ tete gua. Ɔti mɔɔ kakula raalɛ ne ɛlɛka ahile Neeman aye ne la ɛne: ‘Me kunlu a anrɛɛ me menle kɛhɔ Gyihova ngapezonli ne mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la ɛkɛ ne. Anrɛɛ ɔbayɛ ye kokobɛ ne ayile.’ Amozii bɛhanle ɛhye bɛhilele bɛlɛra ne ahu ne.

Neeman akunlu a anrɛɛ yede kpɔkɛ; ɔti ɔbɔle kpɔkɛ kɛ ɔkɔ Yizilayɛ. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔdwule ɛkɛ ne la, ɔhɔle Yilaehya sua nu. Yilaehya manle ye sonvolɛ ne vindele razele Neeman kɛ ɔhɔbia Azule Dwɔdan ne anu fane nsuu. Ɛhye hanle Neeman ɛya kpole na ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Azule mɔɔ wɔ me sua zo la biala le kpalɛ tɛla azule mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la!’ Ɔhanle ɛhye ɔwiele la, Neeman dɔle adenle zo kɛ ɔkɔ.

Na ye sonvolɛma ne mɔ zele ye kɛ: ‘Yɛmenle, saa Yilaehya hanle kɛ ɛyɛ debie ɛsesebɛ bie a, anrɛɛ ɛkɛyɛ. Na duzu ati a ɛnrɛhola ɛnrɛdɔ azule ne anu kɛmɔ yeha la ɛ?’ Neeman diele ye sonvolɛma ne na ɔhɔdɔle Azule Dwɔdan ne anu fane nsuu. Mɔɔ ɔyɛle ye zɔ la, ɔdele kpɔkɛ na ɔ nwo yɛle kɛnlɛma bieko!

Neeman anye liele kpole kpalɛ. Ɔziale ɔhɔle Yilaehya ɛkɛ ne na ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Kɛkala, akee menwu kɛ Nyamenle ne mɔɔ wɔ Yizilayɛ la a le nɔhalɛ Nyamenle kokye mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ye muala azo a. Zɔhane ati, mesɛlɛ wɔ, die me sa nu ahyɛlɛdeɛ ɛhye.’ Na Yilaehya buale ye kɛ: ‘Kyɛkyɛ, menrɛlie.’ Ɛnee Yilaehya ze ye kɛ ɔle ɛtane kɛ ɔkɛlie ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne, ɔluakɛ Gyihova a yɛle Neeman ayile a. Noko ɛnee Yilaehya sonvolɛ Gɛheezae kulo ninyɛne ne.

Ɔti mɔɔ Gɛheezae yɛle la ɛne. Mekɛ mɔɔ Neeman hɔle la, Gɛheezae nriandile doale ye. Gɛheezae zele ye kɛ: ‘Yilaehya ɛzoa me kɛ membaze wɔ kɛ maa ye ahyɛlɛdeɛ ne bie na ɔva ɔmaa ɔ gɔnwo mɔ mɔɔ ɛra kɛ bɛbakpɔla ye la.’ Nɔhalɛ nu ɛhye le adalɛ. Noko ɛnee Neeman ɛnze kɛ ɔle adalɛ; ɔti ɔmanle Gɛheezae ninyɛne ne bie.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Gɛheezae ziale rale sua nu la, ɛnee Yilaehya ze mɔɔ yeyɛ a. Ɛnee Gyihova ɛha ɛhile ye. Yemɔti ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Ɔluakɛ wɔyɛ ɛtane ɛhye la ati, Neeman kokobɛ ne badila wɔ.’ Na ɛkɛ ne ala, ɔyɛle zɔ!

Duzu a yɛkola yɛsukoa yɛfi ɛhye anu a? Mɔɔ lumua la, ɔwɔ kɛ yɛyɛ kɛ kakula raalɛ ekyi ne la na yɛka Gyihova anwo edwɛkɛ yɛkile awie mɔ. Ɛhye ɛyɛlɛ le nvasoɛ dɔɔnwo. Mɔɔ tɔ zo nwiɔ, ɔnle kɛ yɛmemaa yɛ nwo zo kɛmɔ Neeman lumua yɛle la, emomu ɔwɔ kɛ yɛtie Nyamenle azonvolɛ ne mɔ. Mɔɔ tɔ zo nsa, ɔnle kɛ yɛbɔ adalɛ kɛ Gɛheezae la. Asoo yɛnrɛhola yɛnrɛzukoa dɔɔnwo yɛnrɛvi Baebolo ne ɛgengalɛ nu ɔ?2 Arelemgbunli 5:1-27. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA nrenya ne mɔɔ wɔ nzule ne anu la. Ɔ nwo ɛhyele ye kpalɛ, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Fɛlɛ ne ɛlɛba ame ye! Ɛze nrenya ye sonla holɛ ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Dwona. Maa yɛnlea deɛ mɔɔ ɔti ɔ nwo ɛhyele ye kpole la.

Dwona le Gyihova ngapezonli. Ngapezonli Yilaehya wule la yeangyɛ biala yɛɛ Gyihova zele Dwona kɛ: ‘Kɔ suakpole Nenɛvɛ mɔɔ ɛlie duma kpole la azo. Menli mɔɔ wɔ sua ne azo la ɛtane ɛyɛ kpole somaa, na mekulo kɛ ɛka nwolɛ edwɛkɛ ɛkile bɛ.’

Noko ɛnee Dwona ɛngulo kɛ ɔkɛhɔ. Ɔti ɔvole meli mɔɔ ɛngɔ Nenɛvɛ na emomu ɔlɛkɔ ɛleka gyɛne la anu. Ɛnee Gyihova anye ɛnlie nwolɛ kɛ Dwona ɛlɛnriandi la. Yemɔti Ɔmanle ahumu kpole bie dule. Ɔdule kpole mɔɔ ɛnee asɛɛ meli ne ɛbutu ɛwie a. Menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la ahonle dule kpalɛ, na bɛdeɛdeanle nu bɛzɛlɛle bɛ nyamenle ne mɔ moalɛ. Amozii Dwona hanle hilele bɛ kɛ: ‘Mesonle Gyihova, Nyamenle ne mɔɔ bɔle anwuma nee azɛlɛ ye la. Melɛnriandi meavi mɔɔ Gyihova ɛze me kɛ menyɛ la anwo.’ Menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la bizale ye kɛ: ‘Duzu debie a yɛva yɛyɛ wɔ na ahumu ye agua amaa yɛ a?’

Dwona buale bɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛvuandi me bɛdo nyevile ne anu, na nyevile ne bagua fɛɛnye.’ Ɛnee menli mɔɔ ka meli ne la ɛngulo kɛ bɛkɛyɛ, noko mekɛ mɔɔ ahumu ne anloa yɛle se la bɛvuandinle Dwona bɛdole nyevile ne anu. Ɛkɛ ne ala ahumu ne gyakyile, na nyevile ne guale diinyi.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Dwona ɛlɛnoma la, fɛlɛ kpole bie ramenle ye. Noko yeanwu. Ɔlile kenle kɔkɔlɛ nsa, alehyenlɛ nee aledwolɛ wɔ fɛlɛ ne akunlu. Dwona nlunle ɔ nwo kɛ yeandie Gyihova na yeangɔ Nenɛvɛ la. Ɔti ɛze mɔɔ ɔyɛle a?

Dwona zɛlɛle Gyihova ɛkɛ ne moalɛ. Akee Gyihova manle fɛlɛ ne hɔkpule Dwona dole file zo. Ɛhye anzi Dwona hɔle Nenɛvɛ. Asoo ɛhye ɛngile kɛzi nwolɛ hyia kɛ yɛtie edwɛkɛ biala mɔɔ Gyihova kɛha la ɔ?Dwona 1-4 Baebolo buluku ne. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ƐHYE bayɛ paladaese anwo nvoninli mɔɔ Nyamenle vale hilele ye ngapezonli Ayezaya la. Ayezaya rale Dwona anzi mekɛ ezinra bie.

Paladaese kile “tola” anzɛɛ “anyelielɛ ɛleka.” Asoo ɔkakye wɔ debie bie mɔɔ yɛlumua yɛnwu ye wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la ɔ? Ɔle kɛ tola kɛnlɛma ne mɔɔ Gyihova Nyamenle vale manle Adam nee Yive la, ɔnle zɔ ɔ? Noko asoo azɛlɛ ye amuala bayɛ paladaese kenlebie?

Gyihova hanle hilele ye ngapezonli Ayezaya kɛ ɔhɛlɛ paladaese fofolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba mɔɔ Nyamenle menli banyia ye la anwo edwɛkɛ. Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Bɛdi nee boane badɛnla anzondwolɛ nu. Nlankɛ mralɛ nee awenade mralɛ babɔ nu adidi, na ngakula anlea bɛ nwo zo. Ɛwɔlɛ mɔɔ anwo yɛ ɛzulolɛ la bɔbɔ ɛnrɛyɛ kakula ekyi mɔɔ kɛli nwɔhoa kɛbikye ye la ɛhwee.’

Menli dɔɔnwo baha kɛ: ‘Ɛhye ɛnrɛzi ɛlɛ. Dahuu ngyegyelɛ wɔ azɛlɛ ye azo, na ɔbahɔ zo dahuu.’ Noko dwenle nwolɛ nea: Aako boni a Nyamenle kyekyele manle Adam nee Yive a?

Nyamenle manle Adam nee Yive dɛnlanle paladaese. Ɔluakɛ bɛyɛle anzosesebɛ bɛtiale Nyamenle la ati a bɛ aako kɛnlɛma ne bɔle bɛ, bɛyɛle mgbanyinli na bɛwule a. Nyamenle ɛbɔ ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɔbava ninyɛne mɔɔ vile Adam nee Yive asa la yeamaa menli mɔɔ kulo ye la.

Wɔ paladaese fofolɛ ne mɔɔ ɛlɛba la anu debie biala ɛnle ɛkɛ ne mɔɔ baboda anzɛɛ bazɛkye awie a. Anzondwolɛ mɔɔ di munli la bara. Menli kɔsɔɔti banyia kpɔkɛdelɛ kpalɛ nee anyelielɛ. Ɔbayɛ kɛ mɔɔ ɛnee Nyamenle kulo kɛ ɔyɛ wɔ mɔlebɛbo ne ala la. Amozii yɛbazukoa kɛzi Nyamenle bayɛ ɛhye la anwo debie.Ayezaya 11:6-⁠9; Yekile 21:3, 4. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

ASOO ɛze deɛ mɔɔ ɔti nrenya ne ɛlɛsɛlɛ Gyihova la ɔ? Duzu ati a yeva ngɛlata ɛhye mɔ yegua Gyihova afɔlemokyea ne anyunlu ɛ? Bɛfɛlɛ nrenya ne Hɛzikaya. Ɔle Yizilayɛ nyiakɛ mbusua nwiɔ ne azo belemgbunli. Na yeyia ngyegyelɛ dɔɔnwo. Duzu ati ɔ?

Ɔluakɛ Aseleama ɛlɔne ɛlumua ɛzɛkye sɔlɔ mbusua 10 ne. Gyihova manle ɛhye anwo adenle ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli zɔhane ɛyɛ ɛtane somaa. Na kɛkala Aseleama ɛlɔne ne ɛra kɛ bɛ nee mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne baho.

Aseleama belemgbunli ne ɛva ngɛlata ɛrɛlɛ Belemgbunli Hɛzikaya. Ngɛlata ɛhye a Hɛzikaya ɛdɛlɛ nu ɛgua Nyamenle anyunlu ɛke la. Ngɛlata ne si Gyihova amgbu, na ɔka ɔkile Hɛzikaya kɛ ɔlie ɔdo nu kɛ ɔnrɛhola bɛ. Ɛhye ati a Hɛzikaya yɛle asɔne kɛ: ‘O Gyihova, die yɛ fi Aselea belemgbunli ne asa nu. Amaa maanle maanle kɔsɔɔti anwu kɛ ɛdawɔ ala a ɛle Nyamenle a.’ Asoo Gyihova badie Hɛzikaya ɔ?

Hɛzikaya le belemgbunli kpalɛ. Ɔnle kɛ Yizilayɛ mbusua 10 belemgbunlililɛ ne azo arelemgbunli ɛtane ne mɔ, anzɛɛ Ehaze, ɔ ze ɛtanevolɛ ne la. Hɛzikaya ɛbɔ mɔdenle ɛli Gyihova mɛla ne mɔ azo. Ɔti Hɛzikaya wiele asɔne ne yɛ la, ngapezonli Ayezaya vale edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ vi Gyihova ɛkɛ ne la hɔmanle ye kɛ: ‘Aselea belemgbunli ne ɛnrɛra Gyɛlusalɛm. Ye ɛlɔnema ne mɔ anu ko bɔbɔ ɛnrɛbikye ye. Bɛnrɛdo ɛda ko bɔbɔ wɔ suakpole ye azo.’ Nea nvoninli ne mɔɔ wɔ mukelɛ ɛhye anu la. Ɛze ɛlɔnema mɔɔ bɛwu bɛgua ɛke la ɔ? Aseleama ɛne. Gyihova zoanle ye anwumabɔvolɛ ko na kenle ko nɔɔzo ɔhunle Aselea ɛlɔnema 185,000. Ɔti Aselea belemgbunli ne angola gyinla na ɔziale ɔhɔle ye sua zo.

Bɛliele mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne, na menli ne dɛnlanle anzondwolɛ nu wɔ mekɛ ekyi anu. Noko mekɛ mɔɔ Hɛzikaya wule la ɔ ra Manasɛ rayɛle belemgbunli. Manasɛ nee ɔ ra Emɔn mɔɔ rale amozii la biala anyɛ belemgbunli kpalɛ. Yemɔti basabasayɛlɛ nee ɛtanelilɛ yile azɛlɛ ne azo bieko. Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Emɔn azonvolɛ ne mɔ hunle ye la, bɛziele ɔ ra Dwosaya belemgbunli wɔ mbusua nwiɔ belemgbunlililɛ ne azo.2 Arelemgbunli 18:1-36; 19:1-37; 21:1-25. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

data.titulo: Yizilayɛma Belemgbunli Kpalɛ Mɔɔ Li Amozi
data.contenido:
MEKƐ mɔɔ Dwosaya rayɛle Yizilayɛ nyiakɛ mbusua nwiɔ ne azo belemgbunli la ɛnee yeli ɛvolɛ mɔtwɛ pɛ. Ɛnee ɔle kakula somaa kɛ ɔkɛli ebia. Ɔti alumua ne mgbanyima bie boale ye manle ɔnleanle manle ne azo.

Dwosaya lile belemgbunli ɛvolɛ nsuu anzi la yɛɛ ɔbɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔkpondɛ Gyihova a. Ɔlile arelemgbunli mgbalɛ le kɛ Devidi, Gyɛhɔhyafate nee Hɛzikaya mɔ neazo ne anzi. Akee mekɛ mɔɔ ɛnee ɔtɛdile ɛvolɛ abulanwiɔ bɔbɔ la, Dwosaya yɛle debie bie akɛnrasesebɛ zo.

Yizilayɛma ɛli ɛtane mekɛ tendenle dɔɔnwo. Ɛnee bɛsonle awozonle. Bɛbɔ bɛ ti aze bɛmaa abaaba. Yemɔti Dwosaya nee ye menli ne hɔle na bɛbɔle ɔ bo kɛ bɛye adalɛ ɛzonlenlɛ bɛavi azɛlɛ ne azo. Ɛnee ɛhye le gyima ɛsesebɛ ɔluakɛ ɛnee menli dɔɔnwo ne ala sonle awozonle. Nea kɛ Dwosaya nee ye menli ne mɔ ɛlɛbubu abaaba ne mɔ wɔ ɛke ɛ.

Ɛhye anzi, Dwosaya kpale mrenya nsa kɛ bɛnlea bɛmaa bɛziezie Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne. Bɛliele ndoloboa bɛvile menli ne ɛkɛ na bɛvale bɛmanle mrenya ɛhye mɔ kɛ bɛva bɛdua kakɛ mɔɔ bɛkɛbɔ ye wɔ gyima ne anwo la. Mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛyɛ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anwo gyima la, ɛsɔfo kpanyinli Helekaya nwunle debie bie mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ la. Ɔnwunle mɛla buluku ne mɔɔ Gyihova manle Mosisi hɛlɛle ye mekɛ tendenle bie mɔɔ ɛnze ɛhɔ la. Ɛnee yeminli yehyɛ.

Bɛvale buluku ne bɛhɔmanle Dwosaya, na ɔzele bɛ kɛ bɛgenga bɛhile ye. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔlɛtie la, ɔnwunle kɛ menli ne ɛnli Gyihova mɛla zo fee. Ɛhye yɛle ye nyane kpole, ɔti ɔsuosuanle ye adɛladeɛ ne mɔ anu, kɛmɔ ɛnwu ye wɔ ɛke la. Ɔse: ‘Gyihova ɛva yɛ nwo ɛya kpole, ɔluakɛ yɛ ze mɔ angola anli ye mɛla ne mɔɔ bɛhɛlɛ ye wɔ buluku ɛhye anu la azo.’ Dwosaya zele ɛsɔfo kpanyinli Helekaya kɛ ɔkpondɛ mɔɔ Gyihova bava ayɛ bɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ. Helekaya hɔle ngapezonli raalɛ Hɛleda ɛkɛ ne na ɔhɔbizale ye. Ɔvale edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ vi Gyihova ɛkɛ ne la ɔmanle ye kɛ ɔva ɔhɔmaa Dwosaya: ‘Gyɛlusalɛm nee menli mɔɔ wɔ zolɛ la amuala bɛanyia bɛ ndeanlɛ ɔluakɛ bɛzonle awozonle na ɛtanelilɛ ɛyi azɛlɛ ne tɛkɛɛ. Noko akee, ɔluakɛ wɔmɔ Dwosaya wɔyɛ mɔɔ le kpalɛ la ati, ndeanlɛ ɛhye bara wɔ ewule nzi.’2 Edwɛkɛsisilɛ 34:1-28. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NEA kɛ menli ne ɛlɛgolo nrenya ne anwo ɛ. Ɛze ye ɔ? Bɛfɛlɛ ye Gyɛlɛmaya. Ɔle Nyamenle ngapezonli mɔɔ anwo hyia kpalɛ a.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Belemgbunli Dwosaya bɔle ɔ bo kɛ ɔsɛkye abaaba ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ azɛlɛ ne azo la, yɛɛ Gyihova yele Gyɛlɛmaya kɛ ɔyɛ ye ngapezonli a. Noko akee, ɛnee Gyɛlɛmaya suzu kɛ ɔle kakula somaa kɛ ɔkɛyɛ ngapezonli. Na Gyihova hanle kɛ ɔbaboa ye.

Gyɛlɛmaya hanle hilele Yizilayɛma kɛ bɛgyakyi ninyɛndane ɛyɛlɛ. Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Awozonle ne mɔ mɔɔ menli ne sonle bɛ la le adalɛ nyamenle.’ Noko Yizilayɛma dɔɔnwo hulole kɛ bɛkɛzonle awozonle tɛla kɛ bɛkɛzonle nɔhalɛ Nyamenle Gyihova. Mekɛ mɔɔ Gyɛlɛmaya zele menli ne kɛ Nyamenle badea bɛ wɔ bɛ ninyɛndane ne anwo la, bɛzelele ye.

Ɛvolɛ dɔɔnwo pɛle nu. Dwosaya wule, na siane nsa anzi ɔ ra Gyɛhɔyakem rayɛle belemgbunli. Gyɛlɛmaya hɔle zo zele menli ne kɛ: ‘Saa bɛangakyi bɛ subane a, bɛbazɛkye Gyɛlusalɛm.’ Ɛsɔfo ne mɔ hyele Gyɛlɛmaya na bɛdeanle nu kɛ: ‘Edwɛkɛ ɛhye mɔɔ wɔha la, ɔfɛta kɛ bɛku wɔ.’ Akee bɛhanle bɛhilele Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ne mɔ kɛ: ‘Ɔwɔ kɛ bɛku Gyɛlɛmaya, ɔluakɛ yedendɛ yetia yɛ suakpole ne.

Duzu a Gyɛlɛmaya bayɛ a? Ɛnee ɔnzulo! Ɔzele bɛ muala kɛ: ‘Gyihova a zoanle me kɛ menga edwɛkɛ ɛhye mengile bɛ a. Saa bɛangyakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne a, Gyihova bazɛkye Gyɛlusalɛm. Bɛyɛ ɛhye nzonlɛ: saa bɛku me a, ɛnee bɛhu sonla mɔɔ ɔtɛyɛle ɛtane biala a.’

Mgbanyima ne mɔ angu Gyɛlɛmaya, noko Yizilayɛma angyakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne mɔ. Amozii Nɛbukadenɛza, Babelɔnma belemgbunli ne, nee Gyɛlusalɛm rahonle. Awieleɛ kolaa ne Nɛbukadenɛza vale Yizilayɛma yɛle ye ngɛkɛlɛ. Ɔvale bɛ nuhua dɔɔnwo ɔhɔle Babelɔn. Nea kɛzi ɔbayɛ a kɛ nyɛvolɛ bie bava wɔ avi wɔ sua zo ahɔ maanle bie mɔɔ ɛnze zo la azo a!Gyɛlɛmaya 1:1-⁠8; 10:1-⁠5; 26:1-16; 2 Arelemgbunli 24:1-17. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

BELEMGBUNLI Nɛbukadenɛza vale Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ze nwoma kpalɛ la amuala hɔle Babelɔn. Ɛhye anzi belemgbunli ne kpale nu yele mgbavolɛ ne mɔ mɔɔ anwo yɛ fɛ kpalɛ na eza bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ la. Mgbavolɛ ɛhye anu nna a ɛnwu bɛ wɔ ɛke la. Ko a le Daneɛle, na nsa ne mɔɔ ɛha la Babelɔnma donle bɛ Hyeedelake, Mehyake, yɛɛ Abɛdenɛgo.

Nɛbukadenɛza bɔle adwenle kɛ ɔtete mgbavolɛ ne mɔ na bazonle wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ. Ɛvolɛ nsa ndeteleɛ ne anzi akee ɔbaye nuhua mɔɔ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ kpalɛ la yeamaa bɛaboa ye wɔ gyimalilɛ nu. Ɛnee Belemgbunli ne kpondɛ kɛ mgbavolɛ ne mɔ nyia anwosesebɛ nee kpɔkɛdelɛ kpalɛ wɔ mekɛ mɔɔ bɛlɛtete bɛ la. Ɔti ɔzele ye azonvolɛ ne mɔ kɛ bɛva aleɛ nee nza kpalɛ mɔɔ ɔdaye mumua ne ɔ nee ye abusua ne di la bie bɛmaa bɛ.

Nea kpavolɛ Daneɛle. Ɛze mɔɔ ɔlɛka yeahile Nɛbukadenɛza sonvolɛ kpanyinli Ahyepinaze la ɔ? Daneɛle ɛlɛka ahile ye kɛ ɔngulo kɛ ɔkɛli ninyɛne mgbalɛ ne mɔɔ vi belemgbunli ɛkponle ne azo la. Ɛhye gyegyele Ahyepinaze. Ɔhanle kɛ: ‘Belemgbunli ɛhile aleɛ nee nza mɔɔ bɛva bɛmaa wɔ la. Na saa wɔanyia anwosesebɛ kɛ ɛ gɔnwo mɔ a, wɔannea a ɔbahu me.’

Yemɔti Daneɛle hɔle sonvolɛ ne mɔɔ Ahyepinaze ɛye ye kɛ ɔnlea ɔdaye nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nsa ne anwo zo la ɛkɛ ne. Ɔzele ye kɛ: ‘Mesɛlɛ wɔ sɔ yɛ nea kenle 10 pɛ. Maa bɛmaa yɛ nya nya yɛli na bɛmaa yɛ nzule yɛnlo. Na fa yɛ to menli mɔɔ ɛlɛdi belemgbunli aleɛ ne la anwo, na nea mɔɔ te kpɔkɛ kpalɛ la.’

Sonvolɛ ne kponlenle zolɛ kɛ ɔbayɛ. Na mekɛ mɔɔ kenle 10 ne dwule la, Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nsa ne nyianle kpɔkɛdelɛ kpalɛ dɛlale mgbavolɛ mɔɔ ɛha la amuala. Ɔti kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛli mɔɔ belemgbunli ne fa maa bɛ la sonvolɛ ne manle bɛhɔle zo bɛlile nya nya ne.

Ɛvolɛ nsa ne dwule la bɛvale mgbavolɛ ne mɔ amuala bɛhɔle Nɛbukadenɛza anyunlu. Mekɛ mɔɔ ɔ nee bɛ muala dendɛle wiele la, belemgbunli ne nwunle Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nsa ne kɛ bɛze nrɛlɛbɛ kpalɛ. Ɔti ɔvale bɛ kɛ bɛboa ye wɔ ye sua nu ɛkɛ ne. Na mekɛ biala mɔɔ belemgbunli ne kɛbiza Daneɛle, Hyeedelake, Mehyake nee Abɛdenɛgo edwɛkɛ anzɛɛ kɛmaa bɛ gyima mɔɔ anu yɛ se kpalɛ la, bɛnyia nwolɛ adwenle mɔnwo 10 bɛtɛla ye ɛsɔfo ne mɔ anzɛɛ nrɛlɛbɛvolɛma ne mɔ.Daneɛle 1:1-21. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia

NƐBUKADENƐZA vale Yizilayɛma mɔɔ ze nwoma kpalɛ la amuala hɔle Babelɔn la ɛvolɛ 10 ɛpɛ nu. Kɛkala nea mɔɔ ɛlɛsi a! Bɛlɛyela Gyɛlusalɛm. Na bɛlɛfa Yizilayɛma mɔɔ bɛangu bɛ la bɛahɔ Babelɔn kɛ pilizama.

Kakye kɛ, ɛhye a Gyihova ngapezoma ne bɔle nwolɛ kɔkɔ kɛ saa menli ne angyakyi bɛ nyɛleɛ ɛtane ne a ɔbazi a. Noko Yizilayɛma ne andie ngapezoma ne. Kɛ anrɛɛ bɛkɛzonle Gyihova la bɛhɔle zolɛ bɛzonlenle awozonle. Ɔti menli ne fɛta ndeanlɛ. Yɛze ɛhye ɔluakɛ Nyamenle ngapezonli Yizikeɛle ka ninyɛndane mɔɔ ɛnee Yizilayɛma ne ɛlɛyɛ la anwo edwɛkɛ kile yɛ.

Asoo ɛze Yizikeɛle ɔ? Ɔboka mgbavolɛ mɔɔ belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale bɛ hɔle Babelɔn ɛvolɛ 10 nee ɔ nzi kolaa na Gyɛlusalɛm ɛzɛkyelɛ ne adwu zo la anwo. Mekɛ zɔhane ala anu a bɛvale Daneɛle nee ɔ gɔnwo mɔ nsa ne, Hyeedelake, Mehyake nee Abɛdenɛgo noko bɛhɔle Babelɔn a.

Mekɛ mɔɔ Yizikeɛle tɛbɔ Babelɔn la, Gyihova yele ninyɛndane mɔɔ ɛnee ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ Gyɛlusalɛm ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la hilele ye. Gyihova luale nwanwane adenle zo a yɛle ɛhye a. Ɛnee Yizikeɛle tɛbɔ Babelɔn amgba, noko Gyihova manle ɔnwunle debie biala mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu la. Na mɔɔ Yizikeɛle nwunle ye la ɛnee yɛ azibɛnwo!

Gyihova zele Yizikeɛle kɛ: ‘Nea ninyɛndane mɔɔ menli ne ɛlɛyɛ ye wɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ye anu la. Nea kɛ bɛdolɔdolɔ nwɔlɛ nee nane ngakyile bɛgua bane ne anwo ɛ. Na nea kɛ Yizilayɛma ɛlɛsonle bɛ ɛ!’ Ɛnee Yizikeɛle kola nwu ninyɛne ɛhye mɔ amuala, na ɔhɛlɛle mɔɔ ɛlɛkɔ zo la ɔdole ɛkɛ.

Gyihova bizale Yizikeɛle kɛ: ‘Ɛze mɔɔ Yizilayɛ mgbanyima ɛlɛyɛ ye wɔ fealera nu la ɔ?’ Ɛhɛe, ɔnwunle ɛhye noko. Bɛle menli 70, na ɛnee bɛ muala bɛlɛsonle adalɛ nyamenle. Ɛnee bɛlɛka kɛ: ‘Gyihova ɛnwu yɛ. Ɔ rɛle ɛvi maanle ne.’

Akee Gyihova hilele Yizikeɛle mraalɛ bie mɔɔ bɛwɔ sɔlɔ ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anlenkɛ ne anyunlu la. Ɛnee bɛdede ɛkɛ ne bɛlɛsonle bozonle Tamɛze. Na nea mrenya ne mɔ mɔɔ wɔ Gyihova ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anlenkɛ ne anyunlu la! Bɛdodo kɛyɛ 25. Yizikeɛle nwunle bɛ. Ɛnee bɛlɛbɔ bɛ ti aze aduduleɛ bɛazonle sɛnzɛne ne!

Gyihova zele kɛ: ‘Menli ɛhye ɛmbu me fee. Tɛ kɛ asɛɛ ninyɛndane ngome a bɛyɛ a, na bɔbɔ bɛba me ɛzonlenlɛ sua ne anu na bɛyɛ ye wɔ ɛkɛ ne!’ Ɔti Gyihova bɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ: ‘Bɛbade me ɛya ne nganeɛ. Na saa bɛsɛkye bɛ a menrɛze bɛ anwuvɔne.’ Gyihova yele ninyɛne ɛhye hilele Yizikeɛle la ye ɛvolɛ kɛyɛ nsa anzi yɛɛ Yizilayɛma dele atua tiale Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza a. Ɔti ɔ nee bɛ hɔhonle. Wɔ ɛvolɛ ko ne foa anzi Babelɔnma bule Gyɛlusalɛm bane ne guale na bɛvale senle bɛyelale suakpole ne dwɛɛ. Bɛhunle menli ne dɔɔnwo anzɛɛ bɛvale bɛ kɛ pilizama bɛhɔle Babelɔn.

Duzu ati a Gyihova manle ɛzɛkyelɛ kpole ɛhye rale Yizilayɛma anwo zo ɛ? Ɛhɛe, ɔluakɛ bɛandie Gyihova yɛɛ bɛanli ye mɛla zo la ati ɔ. Ɛhye kile kɛzi nwolɛ hyia kɛ dahuu yɛyɛ mɔɔ Nyamenle ka kile yɛ la.

Alumua ne menli ekyi bie yɛɛ bɛgyakyile bɛ wɔ Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne zo a. Belemgbunli Nɛbukadenɛza vale Dwuunli bie mɔɔ bɛfɛlɛ ye Gɛdalaya la kɛ ɔnlea menli ɛhye anwo zo. Noko Yizilayɛma bie mɔ hunle Gɛdalaya. Ɛnee akee menli ne sulo kɛ Babelɔnma bazɛkye bɛ muala ɔluakɛ bɛyɛ ɛtane ɛhye la ati. Ɔti Bɛvale Gyɛlɛmaya bɛbokale bɛ nwo na bɛnriandile bɛhɔle Yigyibiti.

Ɛhye manle Yizilayɛ azɛlɛ ne dɔle mgbane mɔɔ ɛnee awie biala ɛnde zolɛ a. Awie andɛnla azɛlɛ ne azo ɛvolɛ 70. Ɔdɔle mgbane bɔkɔɔ. Noko Gyihova bɔle ɛwɔkɛ kɛ ɛvolɛ 70 anzi ɔbava ye menli ne yeazia yeara azɛlɛ ne azo. Kɔkpula zɔhane mekɛ ne, duzu yɛɛ ɛlɛsi Nyamenle menli mɔɔ wɔ Babelɔn, ɛleka mɔɔ bɛva bɛ bɛhɔ la anwo zo a? Maa yɛnlea.2 Arelemgbunli 25:1-26; Gyɛlɛmaya 29:10; Yizikeɛle 1:1-⁠3; 8:1-18. Debiezukoalɛ Kpuyia
